verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents user notification rules: readiness reports check responders' notification rule configurations, and the REST API configures how users are notified. A community report confirms app push followed by a phone call when a page goes unacknowledged. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of SMS and email as page channels, first-party documentation of per-channel rule configuration (channel ordering and delays), and a documented list of supported contact methods.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, pages reach me over the channels I choose — push, SMS, phone call, and email — with per-channel notification rules

citations.quote: ensuring responders have optimal notification rule configurations
add and configure users on a PagerDuty account, including how they're notified by PagerDuty
